limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter wrap but also made `ready_a` high during reset and gated `valid_b` on acceptance of the sixth bit, whereas the reference preserves reset-low readiness and asserts `valid_b` whenever the pre-edge count is five, even during an input stall.

The test exercised reset and a stall before the sixth bit, but its expected values encoded the rewrite’s handshake behavior, so passing those checks did not verify that the original behavior was preserved.
Exhaustively cycling through all 64 payloads added little value for a counter and handshake defect that a few representative words could exercise.
